verdict.rationale: The axis applies to HumanLayer, but the evidence shows no way to tag or mention an agent in a chat thread to discuss or delegate work. The Slack integration only sends task artifact updates outward into channels. The Jira, GitHub, and Linear integrations create tasks from tickets or issues, which is a different capability from in-thread agent tagging.

support.subject: As a developer, I can tag an agent in a chat thread to discuss and delegate a bug or task
